# 🤝 Code of Conduct

## Our Commitment

The VBS Customer Success Academy aims to provide a welcoming, respectful, and professional environment for everyone.

## Expected Behavior

- Be respectful and constructive.
- Welcome feedback and collaboration.
- Focus on improving documentation.
- Use professional language.

## Unacceptable Behavior

- Harassment or discrimination
- Offensive language
- Personal attacks
- Spam or disruptive behavior

## Enforcement

Project maintainers reserve the right to remove content or restrict participation that violates this Code of Conduct.
